channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran says no decision yet on a return to talks with the US
item.description: FM Abbas Araghchi says Iran is working with Oman on routes, but Hormuz shipping depends on US meeting conditions.

item.title: Did the US really destroy Iran’s ballistic missile capability?
item.description: The US claims it destroyed Iran’s missile capability, but a former White House adviser calls that a “pipe dream".

item.title: US President Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz US territory
item.description: US President Donald Trump said he will “soon” declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory.

item.title: 7.7-magnitude earthquake strikes eastern Indonesia
item.description: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia, damaging buildings and sending residents to higher ground.

item.title: At least five killed as magnitude 7.7 quake hits Indonesia
item.description: The death toll is expected to climb further as emergency teams continue search and rescue efforts.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump vows to make Hormuz US territory ‘pretty soon’
item.description: US President Trump says that 'pretty soon' he will declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory once Iran is defeated.

item.title: Lebanon’s PM urges timetable for Israeli withdrawal as Hezbollah slams deal
item.description: Hezbollah criticises Beirut’s approach, accusing officials of exposing the Lebanese army to risks and Israeli pressure.

item.title: Houthi attack on port kills four eroding truce with Yemen’s government
item.description: Six Houthi ballistic missiles struck Yemen's government-held al-Makha port, killing at least four.

item.title: Yemen’s government says Houthi attack on al-Makha kills at least four
item.description: Hostilities are rising between Iran-backed Houthis and Yemen's internationally recognised government.

item.title: Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz a US ‘territory’ amid Iran war
item.description: Control over the strait has been a sticking point in the ongoing ceasefire negotiations between the US and Iran.
